desc:
⚔️ Welcome, Hunter! Your hunt begins now.

How to play:
🌀 Enter gates and explore dangerous dungeons!
🗡️ Battle monsters with your dagger and powerful skills
🖤 Arise defeated enemies to build your shadow army
👑 Summon commanders to fight by your side
💰 Let your shadows roam and earn money
🏠 Expand and upgrade your headquarters
👹 Defeat the dungeon boss and return home stronger!

How powerful can your shadow army become?

Premium Users get +10% money! 

Join the group and community server for codes!
